t: The Manrose MF100T is a 100mm inline mixed flow extractor fan, engineered for high working pressures and efficient air movement in domestic and commercial settings. It achieves a 245m³/hr extraction rate with a low noise level of 22dBA at 3m. Features include a 3-speed setting, selected via an internal dip switch, and an adjustable overrun timer providing up to 30 minutes of post-operation ventilation. The durable ABS plastic construction offers a flush-fit design, double insulation, and an IPX4 rating.
b: Mount in Loft or Ceiling Void
